description: Defines constants, structures, and function prototypes for internal AVDTP (Audio/Video Distribution Transport Protocol) handling in Bluetooth, including roles, signal identifiers, stream states, media types, error codes, and session management.

methods.name: bt_avdtp_register
methods.description: Registers application callback with AVDTP layer.

methods.name: bt_avdtp_register_sep
methods.description: Registers a Stream Endpoint (SEP) with specified media type and role.

methods.name: bt_avdtp_discover
methods.description: Performs a discovery request on an AVDTP session.
